stations.title: Evening report
stations.text: Stops every night with a stack trace

stations.title: Evening boat
stations.text: Takes the report across the river.

captions: The ticket hut at dusk. Bridie wants the evening report, and it has stopped again.
Each night it stops with a stack trace, and a fix at the top line only moves the crash.
You read each trace down to the method that went wrong, and mend only that one.
Now the report runs to the end, with every number in it.
Part 5 begins: when it goes wrong. You can follow a trace to where a mistake was made.
